summary: One-frame event of esv::interrupt::EventSystem: the roll adjustments an interrupt applied to a conditional roll. Filled by the named Toolkit functions esv::interrupt::FillRollAdjustmentEvent(eoc::interrupt::ConditionalRollEvent const&, eoc::interrupt::AppliedChange const&, ConditionalRollAdjustmentOneFrameComponent&) (EoCServer.dll+0x10D1150) and FillEmptyRollAdjustmentEvent (EoCServer.dll+0x10D1130): the event's two roll Guids, roll index and passive, then the AppliedChange's roll adjustments (a copy of the SE struct interrupt::RollAdjustments, Interrupt.h) at +0x30. Never seen alive. Registry total 136 (server row).
